posts.text: A startup's board deck doesn't reconcile: quarterly churn of 0.1 on 0.8-1.8 beginning ARR implies 88-94% gross retention. The deck states 54-76%. Source: 'Coframe Board Meeting Q3 2026,' 26 Aug 2026, actuals through 30 Jun 2026. If your equity offer cites numbers like these, check the math yourself.
